'''''Birth of a Death Star''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] depicting the construction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. It was given out by [[Jag Silon]] to members of the [[Galactic Vacant Building Demolishing Movement]] at the [[Lucky Despot]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This painting is a reward for players of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' that participated in the house packup events in 2007 and 2009. It also became a shared non-tradeable item after game update 10.
